english.title: Driver of a Metro vehicle cause / permit that vehicle to exceed the speed limit for that vehicle on the Midland Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE METRO VEHICLE..), on part of the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the vehicle to exceed the speed indicated on a speed limit sign erected by the operator and applicable to the part of the metro system through which that vehicle was travelling
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 15 and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
